en.headline: CUHK team completes Hong Kong’s first robot-assisted pelvic fracture surgeries
en.dek: Three elderly patients treated since June with a new orthopaedic robotic system that reduced blood loss to 10–20 ml and shortened incisions to under 2 cm.
body: Researchers from the Chinese University of Hong Kong’s Faculty of Medicine said on Friday they had performed the city’s first robot-assisted pelvic fracture reduction and fixation procedures, treating three patients since June with markedly lower blood loss and smaller wounds than traditional open surgery.

Dr Ronald Wong Man-yeung, clinical associate professor in the Department of Orthopaedics and Traumatology, said pelvic fracture surgery is among the most challenging orthopaedic trauma operations because of the dense concentration of blood vessels and vital organs around the pelvis. The new system, he said, offers a safe, precise and minimally invasive alternative that is especially relevant for older patients who often have multiple medical conditions.

According to the faculty, traditional open procedures can involve blood loss of around one litre and incisions longer than 10 cm. In the three cases completed so far, intraoperative blood loss was limited to 10 to 20 ml and the incisions measured less than 2 cm. The patients recovered well. Hong Kong records an estimated 2,000 pelvic fragility fractures each year; the one-year mortality rate for some high-risk patients who cannot undergo major surgery has been cited at about 15 per cent.

The robotic system, the only one of its kind in Hong Kong and already certified by mainland regulators and listed under Hong Kong’s medical-device framework, uses preoperative three-dimensional CT planning and real-time navigation to guide fracture reduction and screw placement. The department said it is working with partners in Beijing and a technology firm on further artificial-intelligence enhancements.

zh.headline: 中大完成全港首例機械人輔助盆骨骨折微創手術
zh.dek: 自6月起已為三名長者完成手術，術中失血僅10至20毫升，傷口縮至不足2厘米。
body: 香港中文大學醫學院周五表示，團隊利用創新骨科機械人手術系統，完成全港首例機械人輔助盆骨骨折復位固定微創手術，自今年6月起已先後為三名病人施行，失血量及傷口均遠少於傳統開放式手術。
矯形外科及創傷學系臨床副教授黃文揚指出，盆骨骨折是骨科創傷中最複雜的手術之一，盆骨周圍血管及重要器官密集，手術風險高。新系統提供安全、精準及微創的選擇，對同時患有多種慢性病的長者尤其有意義。
醫學院指，傳統開放式手術失血可達約一公升，切口超過10厘米；三宗已完成個案的術中失血量僅10至20毫升，傷口不足2厘米，病人術後恢復良好。本港每年約有2000宗盆骨脆性骨折，部分未能承受大手術的高風險病人一年死亡率可達約15%。
該機械人系統為全港唯一一部，已取得內地藥監認證並納入香港醫療儀器行政管理制度。手術前以三維電腦掃描規劃，術中以實時導航引導復位及螺絲固定。系主任容樹恒表示，團隊正與北京積水潭醫院及創科公司合作，進一步開發結合人工智能的下一代技術。
